description: Open source repositories with NO BOUNTIES that still credit reporters with CVEs (GitHub CNA or MITRE), ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: traefik/traefik
repos.description: Cloud native application proxy, reverse proxy and load balancer. No bug bounty program; the project runs an explicitly non-monetary disclosure process where reports are filed as GitHub security advisories, CVEs are assigned by the GitHub CNA and the reporter is named in the advisory credits (e.g. CVE-2026-48020). Latest stable release: v3.7.10 (2026-07-31).

repos.name: redis/redis
repos.description: In-memory data structure store used as a database, cache and message broker. No bug bounty: reports go through the Redis Vulnerability Disclosure Program on HackerOne, which pays no rewards, and fixes are published as GitHub advisories with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-25243). Latest stable release: 8.10.0 (2026-07-29).

repos.name: xwiki/xwiki-platform
repos.description: Generic enterprise wiki platform offering runtime services for applications built on top of it. No bug bounty program; hundreds of published GHSA advisories carry CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA and credit the reporter (e.g. CVE-2026-40105). Latest stable release: xwiki-platform-17.10.11 (2026-07-29), the current long term support branch.
